# Wo seid ihr? — 3

A single roll-table entry written in one note rather than a table row,
with a heading of its own. Invented for this deck.

```card-forge
card:
  system: dino-island
  card-type: roll-table
  language: de
data:
  heading: Wo seid ihr?
  roll: "3"
  roll-min: 3
  roll-max: 3
  description: "In einem Baumhaus, das jemand vor Jahren gebaut und in Eile verlassen hat."
  reference: Regelwerk S. 7
```
